# AML Canada

> AML & Regulatory Compliance Services in Canada. AML and anti-terrorist financing compliance consulting for businesses regulated by FINTRAC under the PCMLTFA.

## Services

- [Canadian address](https://amlcanada.ca/canadian-address.html): A Canadian business address for companies setting up in Canada.
- [MSB registration](https://amlcanada.ca/msb-registration.html): Registration with FINTRAC as a money services business, including foreign MSBs and virtual currency dealers.
- [Compliance programs](https://amlcanada.ca/compliance-programs.html): Policies and procedures, risk assessment and compliance officer support.
- [Effectiveness reviews](https://amlcanada.ca/effectiveness-reviews.html): A structured review of your program, and preparation for a FINTRAC examination.
- [Training](https://amlcanada.ca/training.html): Scenario-based AML training for front-line staff and compliance teams.
